newsitem.title: INDIA: India PFC's $100-mln Eurobond fully subscribed.
newsitem.headline: India PFC's $100-mln Eurobond fully subscribed.

text.p: A $100-million Eurobond issue by India's state-run Power Finance Corp (PFC) has been fully subscribed in the United States, Asia and Europe, the Press Trust of India said on Monday.
The 12-year bullet loan was priced at a coupon of 7.5 percent per annum to yield 135 basis points over the 10-year U.S. treasury rate.
The loan is the firm's first external commercial borrowing in 1997/98 (April-March).

"The success of the issue was important for PFC as it may have to approach the international capital markets frequently to finance its long-term funding requirements," the news agency quoted a PFC official as saying.
